theorem_statement: Voynich running-text token forms obey representation-robust local graphotactic constraints and require at least second-order within-token context; third-order context is admitted only if its own smoothing-robust replay closes.
note: Fail-closed theorem: SGK01 plus all 19 hard-zero lemmas are required; SGK02 is a separate optional strengthening. All REQUIRED dependencies are certified; optional BOUND_ONLY order3 strengthening failed and is excluded.

theorem_statement: An explicit preselected page-family codebook is not part of the certified architecture; page-scale repertoire effects must be represented by mechanisms that survive deletion of that layer.
note: Backed by the preregistered SG1.1 deletion theorem.

theorem_statement: The observed physical-line ED1 attenuation is not certified as an independent avoidance rule once marginals and coarse vertical geometry are preserved.
note: Negative/bounding theorem, not a positive grammar rule.

theorem_statement: Currier A/B may index real lower-dimensional distributional differences, but current manuscript support does not identify Currier as independent of section and Davis hand.
note: Identifiability theorem; no historical/authorial interpretation is licensed.

theorem_statement: Across the frozen transcription family and smoothing grid, the local edge dependency is stronger across within-line SPACE than across physical LINE_BREAK.
note: Direct theorem wrapper over SGK05; worst clean-room effect/null-SD ratio is 2.1336.

theorem_statement: Third-order within-token context is not admitted to the certified core because its incremental predictive gain is smoothing-dependent under the frozen sensitivity grid.

Under the current SG1.1 no-codebook architecture, a banded same-page exact-reuse channel over lags 2-64 improves the targeted lag-2-5 recurrence geometry; banding improves over uniform R64. The data do not establish that lag 1 must be excluded.
note: Current-parent constructive theorem. R64 target ratio 2.2348; banding-over-uniform 2.2219; lag1-exclusion ratio 1.5537 does not resolve.

theorem_statement: Two local conditional graphotactic effects survive independent heldout replay: q-context carries incremental k/t information beyond exact continuation tail, and i-run length carries incremental terminator information beyond short left context. The q effect is majority-transcription robust rather than universal.
note: q: primary ratio 4.77, 4/5 alternate layers resolved positive, JSLI ratio 0.43 unresolved; i-run: both context tests resolve in all six layers, worst ratio 3.52.

theorem_statement: The running-text junction architecture contains a representation-robust previous-token morphology/length residual and a stronger within-line SPACE than LINE_BREAK edge dependency. Complete exact previous-token closure is not certified: TTLI retains a small resolved exact-identity residual, while most other layers do not resolve a positive exact increment.
note: Morphology primary ratio 3.84; 4/5 alternate layers resolve positive with no negative contradiction. TTLI exact residual +0.001036/null SD 0.0003816, ratio 2.72. Universal exact closure therefore fails.
